name: bandit.structural_pair_handoff_live_mcw
description: Current-schema daylight proof that a real idle camp reaches its deterministic 11-hour routine window, dispatches a stable two-person structural outing, commits the complete pair into local ownership with the player staged five OMT west on its route-facing approach, and maintains the pair's cohesion without duplicate ownership.

steps.label: post_load_pair_handoff_fixture_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: post-load gameplay screen for the idle pair-handoff fixture; this is startup footing only
steps.failure_rule: If gameplay does not load, no live pair-handoff proof can be credited.

steps.label: preflight_saved_idle_pair_handoff_target
steps.abort_reason: saved state did not contain the idle five-member camp with zero inherited leads
steps.expected_immediate_state: the camp has five ready members, no inherited spawn heads, zero leads, and no active outing before live cadence begins
steps.failure_rule: If the camp is already active or inherited roster/evidence state can suppress or preselect dispatch, later handoff logs cannot be credited.

steps.label: wait_first_6_hours_toward_11_hour_routine_window
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: six real game hours pass while production owns legacy migration and initializes the exact camp's routine activation clock
steps.failure_rule: If the first bounded wait does not complete, the deterministic 11-hour dispatch window is not reached.

steps.label: wait_second_6_hours_for_pair_dispatch
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the real hourly structural cadence crosses this camp's deterministic 11-hour due boundary and dispatches an autonomous pair toward the discovered road target
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded wait ends without the exact autonomous road dispatch, the probe is inconclusive/red.

steps.label: wait_5_minutes_for_route_waypoint_handoff_and_cohesion
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 5-minute duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: five more real game minutes carry the dispatched pair through its first route waypoint, commit both members into local ownership inside the route-facing reality bubble, and leave a subsequent local turn for assembled cohesion
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded wait ends without a two-member local handoff and a later assembled cohesion pass, the route-waypoint proof is inconclusive/red.

steps.label: open_save_quit_prompt_after_pair_handoff
steps.abort_reason: screen text did not prove the case-sensitive Save and quit prompt before confirming the pair-handoff save
steps.expected_visible_fact: save/quit prompt is visible after the pair-handoff probe
steps.failure_rule: If save/quit cannot be opened, preserve artifacts but do not credit persisted pair ownership.

steps.label: confirm_save_quit_after_pair_handoff
steps.expected_visible_fact: save/quit completed after the pair-handoff probe
steps.failure_rule: If save/quit is unproven, preserve artifacts but do not credit the saved-state audit.

steps.label: audit_saved_current_pair_handoff
steps.abort_reason: saved current-schema outing did not retain one exact pair, local owner/cursor, shared route, and matching physical handoff snapshot
steps.expected_immediate_state: saved state retains one exact two-person structural outing under local ownership with a matching odd-epoch handoff and coherent route cursor
steps.failure_rule: If nested active_outing/local_handoff identity, route, cursor, pair membership, placement, or health is inconsistent, the live proof is red.

steps.label: audit_pair_handoff_and_cohesion_artifact
steps.abort_reason: same-run artifact did not show dispatch, complete two-member owner-last handoff, and successfully assembled cohesion
steps.failure_rule: No live pair-handoff proof credit if any required same-run transition line is absent.

steps.label: audit_no_same_run_pair_dematerialization
steps.abort_reason: the pair dematerialized again during the bounded proof window
steps.failure_rule: A same-run dematerialization makes this local-owner persistence probe inconclusive.

evidence_contract.claim: an idle zero-lead camp autonomously discovers a road target, dispatches one stable two-person structural outing, commits both persisted NPCs into local ownership at a route-facing waypoint, assembles them coherently, and saves one matching current-schema owner/cursor/handoff without same-run dematerialization
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load proof only / inconclusive for pair materialization
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 live pair credit unless startup, idle preflight, elapsed cadence, dispatch, one complete handoff, assembled cohesion, clean save, nested saved-state audit, and no-dematerialization control are all green.
